ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p434/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p434/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p434/r5.claim: The passage vividly depicts Judgment and contrasts the dreadful fate awaiting disbelievers with the good fate of believers.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p434/r5.anchor: A vivid description of the Day of Judgement is drawn

RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r1.claim: Rāzī supplies the implied exchange: the condemned blames Satan for making him transgress, and Satan denies it; the next verse's command not to quarrel and parallels in 38:60–64 support this dialogue.
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r1.anchor: كأن الكافر حينما يلقى في النار يقول : ربنا أطغاني شيطاني ، فيقول الشيطان : ربنا ما أطغيته

RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r2.speaker: الزمخشري
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhshari identifies the companion with Satan, not the witnessing and recording angel.
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r2.anchor: قال الزمخشري : المراد بالقرين في الآية المتقدمة هو الشيطان لا الملك الذي هو شهيد وقعيد

RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r3.speaker: غيره
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r3.claim: Another commentator identifies the companion as the angel rather than Satan.
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r3.anchor: وقال غيره ، المراد الملك لا الشيطان ، وهذا يصلح دليلا لمن قال ذلك

RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r4.claim: If the companion is Satan, the prior declaration that the person is ready for punishment could mean Satan prepared him for Hell through misguidance, apparently conflicting with Satan's denial.
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r4.anchor: هذا الشخص عندي عتيد متعد للنار اعتدته بإغوائي

RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r5.speaker: الزمخشري
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r5.claim: Al-Zamakhshari can reconcile the claims by taking Satan's preparation to mean that he adorned the path, without compelling the person to follow it.
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r5.anchor: أن يقول اعتدته بمعنى زينت له الأمر وما ألجأته فيصح القولان من الشيطان

RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r6.speaker: الزمخشري
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r6.claim: Al-Zamakhshari alternatively places the statements at two moments: Satan first boasts of misguiding humanity, then retracts when he sees their shared punishment and his own penalty.
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r6.anchor: وثانيهما : أن تكون الإشارة إلى حالين : ففي الحالة / الأولى إنما فعلت به ذلك إظهارا للانتقام من بني آدم

RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r7.claim: Verse 23 uses a coordinating waw because the soul's arrival with its driver and the witness's speech are conjoined events; verse 27 lacks two such simultaneous meanings, and the preceding fa does not call for a waw here.
RAZI-FULL:v28p144#3/r7.anchor: وذلك لأن في الأول الإشارة وقعت إلى معنيين مجتمعين ، وأن كل نفس في ذلك الوقت تجيء ومعها سائق ، ويقول الشهيد ذلك القول

RAZI-FULL:v28p145/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p145/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p145/r1.claim: Although one speaker says ربنا, other singular speakers say رب when making personal requests; this scene presents a case with awe rather than asking for an individual favor, so the plural form is apt.
RAZI-FULL:v28p145/r1.anchor: نقول في جميع تلك المواضع القائل طالب ، ولا يحسن أن يقول الطالب : يا رب عمرني واخصصني وأعطني كذا

STUDYQURAN:50:27/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r1.claim: For the meaning of “his companion,” the commentary directs readers to 50:23.
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r1.anchor: For the meaning of his companion, see 50:23c.

STUDYQURAN:50:27/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r2.speaker: Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r2.claim: The companion declares himself innocent of the person's actions.
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r2.anchor: I did not make him rebel declares the companion’s innocence of what the person does (Ṭ)

STUDYQURAN:50:27/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r3.claim: The disclaimer resembles Satan's declaration that he is quit of those who followed his call to disbelief and that he fears God.
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r3.anchor: as when Satan says to human beings after they have followed his injunction to disbelieve, Surely I am quit of you. Truly I fear God

STUDYQURAN:50:27/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r4.claim: Satan elsewhere says he had no authority over people, only called them and they responded, so they should blame themselves.
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r4.anchor: when Satan declares, I had no authority over you, save that I called you, and you responded to me.

STUDYQURAN:50:27/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r5.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r5.claim: These passages show that people bear responsibility for their souls; they would not heed Satan's suggestions if they were not already far astray.
STUDYQURAN:50:27/r5.anchor: Such verses indicate that all human beings bear responsibility for the state of their soul and would not incline to suggestions from Satan

TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r1.claim: The companion denies making the man rebellious or transgressive; the transgression meant here is disbelief in God.
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r1.anchor: قال ابن زيد، في قوله: {ربنا ما أطغيته} [ق: 27] قال: «تبرأ منه»

TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r2.claim: The man himself followed a path far astray from the path of guidance.
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r2.anchor: قال ابن زيد، في قوله: {ربنا ما أطغيته} [ق: 27] قال: «تبرأ منه»

TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r3.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r3.claim: The account informs God's servants that companions will disown one another on Judgment Day.
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r3.anchor: منه عباده، تبرأ بعضهم من بعض يوم القيامة

TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r4.speaker: ابن زيد
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r4.claim: Ibn Zayd says the companion's words mean that he disavowed the condemned man.
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r4.anchor: قال ابن زيد، في قوله: {ربنا ما أطغيته} [ق: 27] قال: «تبرأ منه»

TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r5.speaker: أبو عمران
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r5.claim: Abu Imran likewise explains the companion's statement as disavowal.
TAB-FULL:v21p441#2/r5.anchor: سمعت أبا عمران، يقول في قوله: {ربنا ما أطغيته} [ق: 27] «تبرأ منه»

BURSEVI:v9p99/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p99/r1.claim: Attar’s Persian couplet says the hungry person is never satisfied by bounty and a sieve gains no benefit from accumulating things.
BURSEVI:v9p99/r1.anchor: شم كرسنه سير زنعمت نمى شود

BURSEVI:v9p99/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p99/r2.claim: قال قرينه begins without conjunction because the companion speaks in continuity with his address to the human; the response ربنا likewise begins without conjunction, as do لا تختصموا and ما يبدل القول لدي in the same sequence.
BURSEVI:v9p99/r2.anchor: بغير واو لأن الأول خطاب للإنسان من قرينه ومتصل بكلامه

BURSEVI:v9p99/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p99/r3.claim: The companion is the devil assigned to the unbeliever.

BURSEVI:v9p99/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99/r4.speaker: الكاشفي
BURSEVI:v9p99/r4.claim: Al-Kashifi describes the unbeliever blaming the devil for controlling and misleading him before Hell; the devil is brought forward and denies the accusation.
BURSEVI:v9p99/r4.anchor: قال الكاشفي : ون خواهندكه كافر را در دوزخ افكنند كويد مراه كناهست

BURSEVI:v9p99/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p99/r5.claim: The omitted exchange and accusation are indicated by the next verse’s command not to quarrel.
BURSEVI:v9p99/r5.anchor: ودل على هذا التقاول والسؤال المحذوف قوله لا تختصموا

BURSEVI:v9p99/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p99/r6.claim: ربنا addresses God as our Lord and caretaker.
BURSEVI:v9p99/r6.anchor: {ربنا} أي بروكارما {ما أطغيته} أي ما جعلته طاغيا

BURSEVI:v9p99/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p99/r7.claim: The companion denies making the human tyrannical or causing him to fall into tyranny.
BURSEVI:v9p99/r7.anchor: ما جعلته طاغيا وما أوقعته في الطغيان

BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r1.claim: The companion says he did not force the man into transgression: he was already far from truth, and the companion only enticed him to respond.

BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r2.claim: Satan's enticement affects those already unstable in judgment, inclined to sin, and far from the right path; he invites without compulsion.
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r2.anchor: فإن إغواى الشيطان إنما يوثر فيمن كان مختل الرأي مائلا إلى الفجور ضالا عن طريق الحق

BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r3.claim: This limited role of Satan matches his admission that he had no authority over people beyond inviting them, which they chose to follow.
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r3.anchor: وما كان لي عليكم من سلطان إلا أن دعوتكم فاستجبتم لي

BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r4.speaker: الحديث
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r4.claim: A hadith says the messenger has no power to guide; if guidance were his, everyone would believe, while Iblis only adorns and does not control misguidance.
BURSEVI:v9p99#2/r4.anchor: وفي الحديث إنما أنا رسول وليس إلى من الهداية شيء ولو كانت الهداية إلي لآمن كل من في الأرض

TABATABAI:50:26-28/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r5.claim: The companion is certainly the human's devil, who stays with him and whispers misguidance.
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r5.anchor: وقد تكرر في كلامه تعالى ذكر القرين من الشيطان

TABATABAI:50:26-28/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r6.claim: The devil calls God “our Lord,” including himself and the human because they are disputing together.
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r6.anchor: أضاف الرب إلى نفسه والإنسان الذي هو قرينه لأنهما في مقام الاختصام

TABATABAI:50:26-28/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r7.claim: The devil denies having compelled the human to transgress.

TABATABAI:50:26-28/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r8.claim: The human was ready to accept the devil's whisper and chose to accept it, so the devil denies responsibility for the transgression.
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r8.anchor: متهيئا مستعدا لقبول ما ألقيته إليه تلقاه باختياره

TABATABAI:50:26-28/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r9.claim: The dispute between wrongdoers and their companions was treated earlier in the account of their gathering.
TABATABAI:50:26-28/r9.anchor: وقد تقدم في سورة الصافات تفصيل اختصام الظالمين وأزواجهم

TABRISI:50:25-30/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:50:25-30/r10.speaker: ابن عباس ومجاهد وقتادة
TABRISI:50:25-30/r10.claim: Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, and Qatada identify the companion as the devil who led him astray; he is paired with him in punishment.
TABRISI:50:25-30/r10.anchor: أي شيطانه الذي أغواه عن ابن عباس ومجاهد وقتادة وإنما سمي قرينه لأنه يقرن به في العذاب

TABRISI:50:25-30/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:50:25-30/r11.speaker: غير مسمى
TABRISI:50:25-30/r11.claim: Another view identifies the companion as a human, such as corrupt scholars and leaders whom people follow.
TABRISI:50:25-30/r11.anchor: قرينه من الإنس وهم علماء السوء والمتبوعون

TABRISI:50:25-30/r12.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:50:25-30/r12.speaker: author
TABRISI:50:25-30/r12.claim: The companion denies compelling him into transgression; he fell into error by choosing evil.
TABRISI:50:25-30/r12.anchor: ما أضللته وما أوقعته في الطغيان باستكراه أي لم أجعله طاغيا

TABRISI:50:25-30/r13.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:50:25-30/r13.speaker: author
TABRISI:50:25-30/r13.claim: The denial echoes Satan's statement that he had no power beyond inviting people, which they chose to accept.
TABRISI:50:25-30/r13.anchor: وما كان لي عليكم من سلطان إلا أن دعوتكم فاستجبتم لي

THALABI:v9p102/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p102/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v9p102/r1.claim: The qarin is the satan assigned to this obstinate disbeliever.
THALABI:v9p102/r1.anchor: قال قرينه يعني الشيطان الذي قيض لهذا الكافر العنيد

THALABI:v9p102/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p102/r2.speaker: author
THALABI:v9p102/r2.claim: The satan's denial means that he did not lead the man astray or seduce him.
THALABI:v9p102/r2.anchor: الذي قيض لهذا الكافر العنيد ربنا ما أطغيته

THALABI:v9p102/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p102/r3.speaker: القرظي
THALABI:v9p102/r3.claim: Al-Qurazi takes the satan's words to mean that he did not compel the man to rebel.
THALABI:v9p102/r3.anchor: وقال القرظي: ما أكرهته على الطغيان. ولكن كان في ضلال بعيد عن الحق

THALABI:v9p102/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p102/r4.speaker: ابن عباس ومقاتل
THALABI:v9p102/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas and Muqatil identify the qarin as the recording angel: al-Walid ibn al-Mughira says the angel made him hurry, and the angel denies making him rebel or rush him.
THALABI:v9p102/r4.anchor: وقال ابن عباس، ومقاتل: قال قرينه يعني الملك، وذلك أن الوليد بن المغيرة يقول للملك الذي كان يكتب السيئات

THALABI:v9p102/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p102/r5.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
THALABI:v9p102/r5.claim: Saʿid ibn Jubayr says the disbeliever accuses the angel of adding to the record, while the angel says he recorded only what the man said and did.
THALABI:v9p102/r5.anchor: وقال سعيد بن جبير: يقول الكافر: رب إن الملك زاد علي في الكتابة، فيقول الملك: ربنا ما أطغيته،

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس ومقاتل وابن قتيبة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas through Ata and Muqatil identify the companion as the man's devil; Ibn Qutayba chooses this interpretation.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r1.anchor: فقال ابن عباس في رواية عطاء: يعني قرينه من الشياطين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r2.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r2.claim: On the devil reading, the devil says he did not cause the man's excess by his own power; the man was already far astray, forsaken by God, so the devil was not the cause of his transgression.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r2.anchor: ذكره مقاتل (¬3). ومعنى {ما أطغيته} ما أضللته وأغويته.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r3.speaker: الكلبي وسعيد بن جبير
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r3.claim: Al-Kalbi and Sa'id ibn Jubayr identify the companion as the recording angel; the disbeliever accuses the angel of adding too much to his record.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r3.anchor: وقال الكلبي: يقول الملك: ربنا ما أطغيته (¬5)، وعلى هذا القول المراد بالقرين الملك. وهو قول سعيد بن جبير.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r4.speaker: الفراء
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r4.claim: Al-Farra chooses the angel reading: the disbeliever says the angel hurried him away from repentance, but the angel denies hastening him or adding to his record; the man remained far from repentance.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r4.anchor: واختار الفراء هذا القول فقال: إن الكافر يقول: يا رب إنه كان يعجلني عن التوبة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r5.claim: God tells the two disputants not to quarrel in His presence.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r6.speaker: ابن قتيبة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p402#2/r6.claim: Ibn Qutayba connects the quarrel here to the disputation in 37:27–33, where the two groups blame one another.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:50:27-31/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:50:27-31/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:50:27-31/r1.claim: The devil companion says he did not mislead the person: the person was already far astray and chose to answer the devil's invitation.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:50:27-31/r1.anchor: من الشياطين: { ربنا ما أطغيته } ما أضللته { ولكن كان في ضلال بعيد }

QASHANI:50:27-29/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:50:27-29/r1.speaker: author
QASHANI:50:27-29/r1.claim: The exchanges are imaginative depictions that make their meaning firm in the heart by giving it a form in the imagination.
QASHANI:50:27-29/r1.anchor: هذه المقاولات كلها معنوية مثلت على سبيل التخييل والتصوير لاستحكام المعنى في القلب

QASHANI:50:27-29/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:50:27-29/r2.speaker: author
QASHANI:50:27-29/r2.claim: The unbeliever's accusation and the devil's denial depict conflict between estimative and intellectual faculties, and more broadly between opposing powers such as anger and desire.
QASHANI:50:27-29/r2.anchor: عبارة عن التنازع والتجاذب الواقع بين قوتيه الوهمية والعقلية

QASHANI:50:27-29/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:50:27-29/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:50:27-29/r3.claim: Rational and estimative powers, like disputants seeking pleasure or benefit, cooperate while satisfied, then blame each other in loss because each loves itself and is veiled from unity.

QASHANI:50:27-29/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:50:27-29/r4.speaker: حارثة
QASHANI:50:27-29/r4.claim: Ḥāritha told the Prophet that he saw the people of Hell attacking one another in turn.
QASHANI:50:27-29/r4.anchor: ولذلك قال حارثة رضي الله عنه للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

QASHANI:50:27-29/r5.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:50:27-29/r5.speaker: author
QASHANI:50:27-29/r5.claim: The author says the Prophet approved Ḥāritha's observation and the devil's assertion that the man was already far astray.
QASHANI:50:27-29/r5.anchor: وصوب عليه السلام قوله وقول الشيطان

QASHANI:50:27-29/r6.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:50:27-29/r6.speaker: author
QASHANI:50:27-29/r6.claim: A person far from unity and original nature, turned toward the lower realm and veiled by natural darkness, accepts satanic whispering instead of angelic inspiration.
QASHANI:50:27-29/r6.anchor: لو لم يكن في ضلال عن طريق التوحيد بعيد عن الفطرة الأصلية

QASHANI:50:27-29/r7.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:50:27-29/r7.speaker: author
QASHANI:50:27-29/r7.claim: The sinner's fault is concealment from innate light and acquiring kinship with the devil in darkness.
QASHANI:50:27-29/r7.anchor: فالذنب إنما يكون عليه بالاحتجاب عن نور الفطرة وكتساب الجنسية مع الشيطان

ELMALILI:50:17-29/r11.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:50:17-29/r11.speaker: author
ELMALILI:50:17-29/r11.claim: Elmalılı renders the companion’s defense as denying that he led the person astray and blaming the person’s own distant misguidance.
ELMALILI:50:17-29/r11.anchor: Arkadaşı der: “Ya Rabbenâ, onu ben azdırmadım velâkin kendisi uzak bir dalâl içinde idi”

ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r25.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r25.speaker: author
ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r25.claim: The companion in this exchange is Satan, who had overpowered the unbeliever in worldly life and accompanies him to the afterlife.
ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r25.anchor: Bu karîn, dünyada o kâfire musallat olup âhirette beraber sevkolunan Şeytan olduğu şu sözünden bellidir

ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r26.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r26.speaker: author
ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r26.claim: Satan's defense answers the person's attempted excuse and complaint that Satan made him transgress.
ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r26.anchor: Demek oluyor ki “yâ Rab[^10], beni bu azıttı” diye i‘tizar ve şikayet etmek istemiş

ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r27.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r27.speaker: author
ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r27.claim: Satan says the person was already far from the truth, so he merely approached him, echoing 14:22 that Satan only called people and had no authority over them.
ELMALILI:50:17-29#2/r27.anchor: Yani kendisi haktan uzağa sapmış bulunuyordu da ben ona öyle yanaştım وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍ

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:50:16/r11.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:50:16/r11.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:50:16/r11.claim: The dispute between a person and his companion in this verse is explained in Ibrāhīm 14:22, which identifies the companion and gives his response.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:50:16/r11.anchor: insanın yandaşı ile aralarında geçen tartışma, İbrâhim sûresinde (14/22), yandaşın kim olduğu da açıklanarak şöyle anlatılmıştır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:50:16/r12.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:50:16/r12.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:50:16/r12.claim: Satan says he did not force people: he only invited them, they followed, and they should blame themselves; neither can rescue the other, and he had denied their associating him with God.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:50:16/r12.anchor: Aslında benim sizi zorlayacak gücüm yoktu; benim yaptığım size çağrıda bulunmaktan ibarettir; siz de benim çağrıma uydunuz. O halde beni kınamayın, kendinizi kınayın.

QUSHAYRI:v3p228/r1.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p228/r1.speaker: الملك الموكل
QUSHAYRI:v3p228/r1.claim: The assigned recording angel says he did not hasten the man into a slip and only wrote it after he committed it, answering the unbeliever's claim that the record was premature.
QUSHAYRI:v3p228/r1.anchor: يقول الملك من الحفظة الموكل له : ما أعجلته على الزلة

QUSHAYRI:v3p228/r2.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p228/r2.speaker: الشيطان
QUSHAYRI:v3p228/r2.claim: Alternatively, the companion is the paired Satan, who says in Hell that he did not compel the man's disbelief; the man chose what Satan whispered.
QUSHAYRI:v3p228/r2.anchor: ويقال : هو الشيطان المقرون به ، وحين يلتقيان في جهنم يقول الشيطان : ما أكرهته على كفره

DAMGHANI:v1p378/r1.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p378/r1.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p378/r1.claim: The qarin in this passage is the Satan paired with a human in this world and the next.
DAMGHANI:v1p378/r1.anchor: الثالث القرين الشيطان المقرون بابن آدم في الدنيا والآخرة

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p413/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p413/r4.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p413/r4.claim: One Quranic sense is deviation or error, including the Companion’s denial that he made his associate transgress and the destination prepared for the transgressors.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p413/r4.anchor: وذكر أهل التفسير أن الطغيان في القرآن على أربعة أوجه . أحدها : الضلال

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p419#2/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p419#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p419#2/r1.claim: He refers readers to Taʾwīl Mushkil al-Qurʾān for the explanation of this phrase, without restating it here.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p419#2/r1.anchor: {قال قرينه ربنا ما أطغيته} مفسر في كتاب "تأويل المشكل" (1) .

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p238/r7.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p238/r7.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p238/r7.claim: The companion who denies making the man transgress is his devil from among the jinn.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p238/r7.anchor: وقال قرينه من الشياطين: ربنا ما أطغيته ولكن كان في ضلال بعيد

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p238/r8.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p238/r8.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p238/r8.claim: He links the pairing of wrongdoers with their companions to Arab usage of pairing one camel with another and to the verse about pairing people with fair companions.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p238/r8.anchor: وهذا مثل قوله سبحانه: احشروا الذين ظلموا وأزواجهم

NAHHAS:v4p227/r16.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p227/r16.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p227/r16.claim: The companion says he did not make the person transgress into disbelief; the person followed a path far from truth.
NAHHAS:v4p227/r16.anchor: أي ما جعلته طاغيا أي متعديا إلى الكفر

SAMIN-DURR:50:27/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:50:27/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:50:27/r1.claim: This clause lacks wāw because it begins a new response, as though the unbeliever blamed his companion and the companion denied leading him astray; the preceding clause has wāw to join concurrent events, each soul's arrival with two angels and its companion's words.
SAMIN-DURR:50:27/r1.anchor: جاءت هذه بلا واو؛ لأنها قصد بها الاستئناف؛ كأن الكافر قال: رب هو أطغاني. فقال قرينه:

ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n19/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n19/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n19/r1.claim: Asad contrasts this qarin with the moral consciousness or reason in 50:23: here it is the sinner's instinctive, unrestrained appetites (sa'iq), often symbolized by shaytan; he compares 41:25 and 43:36 and cites Razi on 14:22.
ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n19/r1.anchor: complex of the sinner's instinctive urges and inordinate, unrestrained appetitites summarized in the term sa'iq

ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n20/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n20/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n20/r1.claim: The pronoun “him” or “it” refers to a person's faculty of conscious, controlling reason.
ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n20/r1.anchor: referring to man's faculty of conscious, controlling reason (shahid).

ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n21/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n21/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n21/r1.claim: Evil impulses gain ascendancy only when the conscious mind strays from moral truths; this explains the point of verses 24–25.
ASAD-NOTES:50:27#n21/r1.anchor: man's evil impulses and appetites cannot gain ascendancy unless his conscious mind goes astray from moral verities

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p238/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p238/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p238/r1.claim: Qatāda identifies the companion who answers as Satan.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p238/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله ﴿ قال قرينه ربنا ما أطغيته ﴾ قال قرينه الشيطان

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p238/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p238/r2.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p238/r2.claim: A report from the Prophet says everyone has a jinn companion; God aided the Prophet against his so that it submitted and urged only good.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p238/r2.anchor: وقال منصور بن المعتمر قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ما من أحد إلا وقد وكل به قرينه من الجن

ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r1.claim: The speaking companion is the devil assigned to the person.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r1.anchor: قال قرينه أي الشيطان المقيض له

ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r2.claim: The companion begins a fresh sentence in dialogue and answers omitted prior speech inferred from the person's accusation.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r2.anchor: لما أنها جواب لمحذوف دل عليه قوله تعالى : ( ربنا ما أطغيته

ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r3.claim: The preceding sentence is coordinated to show the soul arrives with angels and companion together; the reply is independent.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r3.anchor: بخلاف الجملة الأولى فإنها واجبة العطف على ما قبلها

ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r4.claim: The devil says the person was far from truth and that he only encouraged him without coercion, as in 14:22.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p186#2/r4.anchor: فأعنته عليه بالأغواء والدعوة إليه من غير قسر ولا إلجاء فهو كما قدمنا نظير ( وما كان لي عليكم من سلطان )

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r4.claim: The companion who disclaims responsibility is the devil assigned to this unbeliever.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r4.anchor: يعني الشيطان الذي قيض لهذا الكافر

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r5.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r5.claim: The devil says he neither led the person astray nor enticed him.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r6.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r6.claim: The devil disowns him because he strayed far from truth and would not return to it.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r6.anchor: طويل لا يرجع عنه إلى الحق

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r7.speaker: ابن عباس وسعيد بن جبير ومقاتل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas, Saʿid ibn Jubayr, and Muqatil identify the companion as the recording angel, not the devil.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r7.anchor: قال ابن عباس وسعيد بن جبير ومقاتل: "قال قرينه" يعني: الملك

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r8.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r8.claim: Saʿid ibn Jubayr says the unbeliever accuses the recording angel of adding to the record; the angel says he wrote only what the man said and did.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p361/r8.anchor: يقول الكافر يا رب إن الملك زاد علي في الكتابة

BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r1.claim: The companion is the devil assigned to the person.
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r1.anchor: أي الشيطان المقيض له، وإنما استؤنفت

BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r2.claim: The companion's statement begins a new sentence, as in narrated dialogue, and answers an omitted accusation indicated by context.

BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r3.claim: The implied accusation is that the companion led the unbeliever astray; the devil answers that he did not make him transgress.

BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r4.claim: The companion says he merely aided existing misguidance; satanic temptation affects those already unsound in judgment and inclined to wickedness.
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r4.anchor: فأعنته عليه فإن إغواء الشياطين إنما يؤثر فيمن كان مختل الرأي

BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r5.claim: Unlike this answer, the preceding statement must be joined to what came before, indicating the person's arrival with two angels and the companion's speech together.
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r5.anchor: بخلاف الأولى فإنها واجبة العطف على ما قبلها

BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r6.claim: The companion's defense resembles Satan's admission that he only called people and they responded.
BAYDAWI-FULL:50:27-28/r6.anchor: وما كان لى عليكم من سلطن إلا أن دعوتكم فاستجبتم لى

BIQAI-FULL:v7p260/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p260/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p260/r1.claim: The companion answers the expected accusation that he caused the person’s rebellion: he lacked power over him, who was already deeply astray by disposition.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p260/r1.anchor: فإنه لا سلطان لي عليه وأنت أعلم بذلك

BIQAI-FULL:v7p260/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p260/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p260/r2.claim: The person’s innate, pervasive misguidance made him rush toward what angers God without needing even the slightest prompting.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p260/r2.anchor: محيط به من جميع جوانبه لا يمكن رجوعه معه

DURR-FULL:v7p600/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p600/r8.speaker: ابن جريج
DURR-FULL:v7p600/r8.claim: Ibn Jurayj says the companion who denies having led the person astray is that person's Satan.
DURR-FULL:v7p600/r8.anchor: وفي قوله {قال قرينه ربنا ما أطغيته} قال: هذا شيطانه

DURR-FULL:v7p600/r12.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p600/r12.speaker: رسول الله
DURR-FULL:v7p600/r12.claim: The Prophet says everyone has a jinn companion; God helped him against his companion, who submitted and commands him only to good.
DURR-FULL:v7p600/r12.anchor: عن منصور قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: ما من أحد إلا وقد وكل به قرينه من الجن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p298/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p298/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p298/r5.claim: The subsequent account describes resurrection and recompense, from the trumpet blast through 'with Us is more.'
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p298/r5.anchor: ووصف البعث وصف الجزاء من قوله : { ونفخ في الصور إلى قوله : ولدينا مزيد } ( ق : 20 35 ) .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r6.claim: The uncoordinated قال follows Qur'anic dialogue style and signals an omitted prior exchange: the condemned blamed his companion for leading him astray, and the companion denied making him transgress.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r6.anchor: حكاية قول القرين بالأسلوب المتبع في حكاية المقاولات في القرآن وهو أسلوب الفصل دون عطف فعل القول على شيء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r7.claim: The omitted exchange is stated explicitly in 38:59–61; this is the companion already mentioned in 50:23, who says he has the record ready.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r7.anchor: وقد حكي ذلك في سورة ص صريحا بقوله :

IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r8.claim: The author reconstructs the exchange: the stubborn unbeliever tries to disown disbelief and blame the companion who adorned it, and the companion denies making him transgress.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p312/r8.anchor: وتقدير المطوي هنا : أن الكفار العنيد لما قدم إلى النار أراد التنصل من كفره وعناده وألقى تبعته على قرينه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r1.claim: Ṭughyān is exceeding bounds in arrogance, oppression, or unbelief; its verb occurs with yāʾ and wāw forms. ما أطغيته means he did not make him tyrannical by commanding or enticing him.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r1.anchor: والطغيان : تجاوز الحد في التعاظم والظلم والكفر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r2.claim: The companion's qualification responds to their close association, especially if the companion is the assigned devil: association might suggest that the devil prompted his excess, which he denies.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r2.anchor: والاستدراك ناشىء عن شدة المقارنة بينه وبين قرينه لا سيما إذا كان المراد بالقرين شيطانه المقيض له

IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r3.claim: The companion says the person was already astray, so companionship did not cause his misguidance; this resembles the disavowal in 2:166.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r3.anchor: فأخبر القرين بأن صاحبه ضال من قبل فلم يكن اقترانه معه في التقييض أو في الصحبة بزائد إياه إضلالا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r4.claim: كان signals that the misguidance was original and enduring in the person's makeup.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r4.anchor: وفعل { كان } لإفادة أن الضلال ثابت له بالأصالة ملازم لتكوينه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r5.claim: Baʿīd metaphorically describes extreme misguidance, like a distant place or time; it reinforces the lasting force of كان and echoes 4:116.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r5.anchor: والبعيد : مستعار للبالغ في قوة النوع حدا لا يبلغ إليه إدراك العاقل بسهولة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r6.claim: His deeply rooted misguidance shows he was not merely following another's prompting, since a follower is not usually as firmly established as an independent investigator.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v26p314/r6.anchor: أن تمكن الضلال منه يدل على أنه ليس فيه بتابع لما يمليه غيره عليه لأن شأن التابع في شيء أن لا يكون مكينا فيه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p162#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p162#2/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p162#2/r10.claim: The companion in this verse need not be the companion in 50:27, since companionship occurs in several forms.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p162#2/r10.anchor: والقرين الذي في هذه الآية، غير القرين الذي في قوله: قال قرينه ربنا ما أطغيته

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r15.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r15.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r15.claim: On this reading, the passage concerns human beings and the devils who misled them; the worldly Satan moves to absolve itself by denying that it made its companion transgress.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r15.anchor: ويتضمن القول حينئذ بني آدم والشياطين المغوين لهم في الدنيا، ولذلك تحرك القرين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r16.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r16.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r16.claim: Satan's denial is false in general: it caused transgression by whispering and beautifying evil, while God caused it by creation under His prior decree, which is just and admits no other lord.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r16.anchor: والحقيقة أنه أطغاه بالوسوسة والتزين، وأطغاه الله بالخلق، والاختراع حسب سابق قضائه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r17.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r17.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r17.claim: Calling the misguidance 'far' intensifies the description: returning to guidance was difficult for the person.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p163/r17.anchor: وبوصف الضلال بالبعيد مبالغة، أي لتعذر رجوعه إلى الهدى.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس ومجاهد وقتادة والجمهور
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r1.claim: The companion is Satan; the passage abbreviates the exchange in which the human accuses Satan of leading him astray.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r1.anchor: شيطانه قاله ابن عباس ومجاهد وقتادة والجمهور وفي الكلام اختصار

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r2.claim: Satan answers that he lacked power to force the human into error; the human transgressed through his own misguidance.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r2.anchor: أي لم يكن لي قوة على إضلاله بالإكراه وإنما طغى هو بضلاله

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r3.claim: An alternative identifies the companion as the angel who recorded the person’s sins.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r3.anchor: والثاني أنه الملك الذي كان يكتب السيئات

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r4.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r4.claim: On this account the unbeliever accuses the angel of adding to the record, and the angel denies adding anything.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r4.anchor: أحدهما أنه يقول زاد علي فيما كتب فيقول الملك ما أطغيته أي ما زدت عليه قاله سعيد بن جبير

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r5.speaker: الفراء
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r5.claim: Al-Farrāʾ says the unbeliever claims that the angel kept him from repenting, which the angel denies.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r5.anchor: أنه يقول كان يعجلني عن التوبة فيقول ربنا ما أطغيته هذا قول الفراء

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p17#2/r6.claim: ‘Far misguidance’ means being far from guidance.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Qatadah, and others identify the companion as the Satan assigned to the person.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس، ومجاهد، وقتادة، وغيرهم: هو الشيطان الذي وكل به

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r2.claim: At the Resurrection, Satan disowns the disbeliever, saying he did not mislead him; the man was already far astray, receptive to falsehood and resistant to truth.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r2.anchor: أي: ما أضللته، {ولكن كان في ضلال بعيد} أي: بل كان هو في نفسه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r3.claim: The denial echoes Satan’s declaration that he only invited people and they chose to follow him, so they should blame themselves.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p403/r3.anchor: في قوله: {وقال الشيطان لما قضي الأمر إن الله وعدكم وعد الحق

JISHUMI:v9p6561/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6561/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6561/r3.claim: God is just in making each person answerable for himself and does not wrong anyone by disputing with him on the basis of what he knows.
JISHUMI:v9p6561/r3.anchor: لقد عدل من جعلك حسيب نفسك، وما ظلمك من جادلك على علمك

JISHUMI:v9p6561/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6561/r14.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6561/r14.claim: Ṭughyān is exceeding the limit in corruption; aṭghā means causing someone to transgress.
JISHUMI:v9p6561/r14.anchor: والطغيان: تجاوز الحد في الفساد، طغى يطغى طغيا فهو طاغ

MUQATIL:50:27-30/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:50:27-30/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:50:27-30/r1.claim: The companion is the person's devil, who used to embellish falsehood and evil for him.
MUQATIL:50:27-30/r1.anchor: يعني صاحبه وهو شيطانه الذي كان يزين له الباطل والشر

MUQATIL:50:27-30/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:50:27-30/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:50:27-30/r2.claim: The devil excuses himself by saying he lacked power to lead the person astray without God's authority.
MUQATIL:50:27-30/r2.anchor: لم يكن لي قوة أن أضله بغير سلطانك

MUQATIL:50:27-30/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:50:27-30/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:50:27-30/r3.claim: Muqatil identifies the man in distant error as al-Walid ibn al-Mughira al-Makhzumi, who was in prolonged loss in worldly life.
MUQATIL:50:27-30/r3.anchor: ولكن كان في الدنيا الوليد بن المغيرة المخزومي في ضلال بعيد في خسران طويل

NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r1.speaker: مجاهد
NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r1.claim: Mujahid's interpretation identifies the companion as the Satan paired with the person; Nasafi says the wording supports Mujahid.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r1.anchor: اى شيطانه الذى قرن به وهو شاهد لمجاهد

NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r2.claim: This clause lacks a coordinating wāw because it begins a new quoted exchange; the previous clause required coordination to combine the soul's arrival with its companion's statement, as in the Moses–Pharaoh dialogue.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r2.anchor: وانما اخليت هذه الجملة عن الواو دون الاولى لان الاولى واجب عطفها للدلالة على الجمع بين معناها ومعنى ما قبلها في الحصول

NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r3.claim: The imagined exchange is that the unbeliever blames his companion for making him rebel, and the companion replies that he did not lead him into rebellion; the man chose distant error over guidance.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p173#4/r3.anchor: اعنى مجىء كل نفس مع الملكين وقول قرينه ما قال له واما هذه نهى مستأنفة كما نستأنف الجمل الواقعة في حكاية التقاول

QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r25.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r25.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r25.claim: The companion here is Satan, who disowns the obstinate unbeliever and says he did not make him transgress; the man chose misguidance and accepted Satan’s call.
QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r25.anchor: قال قرينه ربنا مآ أطغيته } يعني الشيطان

QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r26.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r26.speaker: المهدوي
QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r26.claim: Al-Mahdawī says the companion in this verse is Satan, with no disagreement on this identification.
QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r26.anchor: وقرينه هنا هو شيطانه بغير اختلاف. حكاه المهدوي

QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r27.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r27.speaker: ابن عباس ومقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r27.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and Muqātil instead identify the companion as the recording angel: al-Walīd says the angel hurried him, and the angel denies causing his transgression.
QURTUBI-FULL:50:23-27/r27.anchor: وحكى الثعلبي قال ابن عباس ومقاتل: قرينه الملك وذلك أن الوليد بن المغيرة يقول للملك الذي كان يكتب سيئاته: رب إنه أعجلني، فيقول الملك: ربنا ما أطغيته
